title: New pixel lanterns with polished gold
desc: J on 604: "do new lanterns, the depth of the dark lantern is just the level of complexity and pixelated design, but of course i was expecting a more polished version of the gold on them". Six new designs on the Dark Lantern's pixel grid with its glass, and polished gold: lit lips, a specular column, deep undersides, engraved bands.

takes.name: Vault
takes.facts: rounded-square glass column held by four fluted gold corner pillars; stepped pyramid roof with a finial ball and ring; 1,966 boxes

takes.name: Bell
takes.facts: bell-shaped glass widening to the foot, eight polished gold ribs, a scalloped crown, a ring handle; 4,165 boxes

takes.name: Gourd
takes.facts: two stacked glass bulbs, an engraved zig-zag gold cuff at the waist, a petal crown and a tall bail; 4,497 boxes

takes.name: Hex classic
takes.facts: classic hexagonal lantern: panels widening upward, proud gold mullions, a vented hex dome, a swing bail; 3,816 boxes

takes.name: Crystal
takes.facts: tall eight-sided crystal held in gold claws at both ends, a hanging ring on top; 3,838 boxes

takes.name: Armillary
takes.facts: glass sphere inside three polished gold rings (an armillary) on a stepped pedestal; 3,636 boxes
